label: Retron system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a retron locus encoding a reverse transcriptase, an msr/msd non-coding RNA that yields multicopy single-stranded DNA, and an associated effector whose activation can inhibit bacteriophage propagation through abortive infection.
observations: Retron branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual retron reverse-transcriptase genes, reverse transcriptase proteins, msr/msd non-coding RNAs, msDNA biosynthesis, RcaT-containing tripartite toxin-antitoxin mechanism classes, RecBCD guarding by Ec48, Retron-Septu subtypes, source database rows naming one retron locus, and other antiphage systems such as BREX, DISARM, CBASS, Gabija, Hachiman, Shedu, Thoeris, Zorya, Kiwa, Lamassu, Septu, Druantia, phosphorothioate defense, CRISPR-Cas, and abortive infection families.
